knowledge_graph.title: Crestview High School
knowledge_graph.description: Crestview High School is the only high school in the city of Crestview, Florida. It was founded in 1926, and was part of a racially segregated system, serving only white students until 1966, when the students from Carver-Hill, the school for African-Americans, were transferred there.
